title: Kernel-based identification of nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems
summary: Port-Hamiltonian systems provide a structured framework for modeling physical systems by explicitly capturing their energy storage, dissipation, and exchange. However, deriving such models often requires detailed physical insight and precise knowledge of system parameters, which may not be available in practice. In this paper, we propose a kernel-based framework for the identification of port-Hamiltonian systems from input-state-output data.
